request.initial_prompt: _Page._ Not by my consent, I promise you. The gentleman is of no having: he kept company with the wild prince and Poins; he is of too high a region; he knows too much. No, he shall not knit a knot in his fortunes with the finger of my substance: if he take her, let him take her 65 simply; the wealth I have waits on my consent, and my consent goes not that way.

raw_segments.text: Page, not by my consent, I promise you. The gentleman is of no having. He kept company with the wild prince and Poins. He is of too high a region. He knows too much. No, he shall not knit a knot in his fortunes with the finger of my substance. If he take her, let him take her 65 simply. The wealth I have waits on my consent, and my consent goes not that way.
